hook: Anna and Ben plan a dinner for friends.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: We have to cook for friends.

translation.vi: Chúng ta phải nấu ăn cho bạn bè.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: Do we have to cook vegetables?

translation.vi: Chúng ta có phải nấu rau không?

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Yes, we have to use vegetables.

translation.vi: Ừ, chúng ta phải dùng rau.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: We don't have to buy meat.

translation.vi: Chúng ta không phải mua thịt.

gloss.en: a plant we eat as food
the room where we cook food

grammar_notes: We use 'have to' for things that are necessary. We use 'don't have to' for things that are not necessary.
interaction_prompts: What do you have to do this week? What don't you have to do?
